blocks.text: Like the choir, the teaching ministry carries one of the oldest obligations in the priesthood, dating to the Old Testament - most of its prophets were teachers, and Jesus Himself taught. This group is made up of trained, educated, and informed workers who assist the Pastors in educating the church morally and spiritually; their impact on the church's spiritual growth is significant.

In the RCCG, the teaching department comprises the Sunday School unit and the Children's/Teenagers' Teachers, and also includes units like the Believers'/Baptismal Class and the Workers-in-Training Class. All of these are supervised nationally by the Directorate of Christian Education.

cards.heading: Functions of the Sunday School Department

blocks.text: Sunday School teachers are responsible for:

items: Previewing the Sunday School and Baptismal/Believers' teaching manuals to prepare for the following Sunday's service.
Preparing materials for the Tuesday "Digging Deep" session.
Providing counsel to their students and monitoring their steady spiritual growth.
Preparing candidates for baptism.
Training volunteers as workers in the church.
Providing regular reports of the department's activities to the Pastorate.

cards.heading: Qualities of a Sunday School teacher

blocks.text: An intending teacher needs to be:

items: Literate - educated, informed, and a regular reader of the Bible.
Teachable - open to other people's ideas, since no one is an island of knowledge.
A good communicator - able to conceptualise and express divine truth in language uneducated people can easily grasp.
A model of what they teach - otherwise, they become a misfit for the role.
Mature and friendly - necessary to handle the intellectual needs of students well.
Knowledgeable - well informed on the subject matter, to avoid confusing or misleading students.
Bold and confident - a teacher also acts as a watchman, gently rebuking evil and instructing students toward righteous living.
Well-mannered - a teacher's own life and conduct must never contradict their message.
Patient - turning knowledge into character takes time, and a teacher shouldn't give up easily on students.
Prayerful - no divine assignment succeeds without time spent in prayer.
Keeping children gainfully engaged, preventing them from wandering during service.
Providing quality Christian education for children in the church.
Organising special children's events that impact their lives positively.
Counselling children on academic, intellectual, and spiritual matters.
Modelling growth and maturity for children in all areas of life.
Assisting children in prayer to overcome personal struggles.
Providing regular reports of the department's activities to the Pastorate.

blocks.text: The qualifications are the same as those of a Sunday School teacher, with a few additional attributes: a genuine passion and love for children, since not everyone can manage their particular habits well; an ability to understand and speak their language; tolerance, since a critical spirit never succeeds with children; dependability, since children commit fully to people they trust; and moral uprightness, since that same trust makes it essential that a teacher never takes advantage of a child in any way, particularly male teachers toward female teenagers, where the consequences of any breach of trust would be especially severe.
